content.user_title: Refine Posts Into Your Brand Voice
content.value_statement: Different contributors can make social content sound inconsistent. This skill applies supplied voice guidance to produce clear, consistent, platform-ready drafts without changing approved claims.
actual_capabilities: Extract voice traits, banned language, terminology, reading level, and CTA style from supplied guidance.
Edit social copy for clarity, confidence, specificity, inclusivity, and platform fit.
Preserve supplied links, product names, factual qualifiers, and required disclosures.
Produce a master post and platform-specific variants.
Flag missing voice guidance as an assumption.
Hold material claim changes for user approval before publishing or scheduling.
limitations: It needs useful brand guidance or examples for reliable voice matching.
It does not independently verify factual claims, legal requirements, or disclosures.
It does not publish, schedule, or manage social media accounts.
Platform-specific output depends on the available platform-reference information.

use_cases.title: Standardize Campaign Copy
use_cases.description: Turn several campaign drafts into consistent posts for a coordinated social media launch.

use_cases.title: Refine Client Content
use_cases.description: Apply client-approved facts and tone rules to polish agency copy for each platform.

use_cases.title: Scale Daily Publishing
use_cases.description: Reduce routine editing time while retaining a recognizable voice across recurring posts.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite One Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this post in our brand voice. Preserve every factual claim and return one polished version.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Voice Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this draft using these voice rules: [rules]. Keep the meaning, improve clarity, and flag unclear claims.

prompt_templates.title: Create Platform Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this approved message into variants for [platforms]. Preserve the facts, follow each platform format, and keep the same voice.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Publishing Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit these drafts against the attached brand guidance, create platform variants, preserve facts, and identify posts needing human review.

best_practices: Provide a short voice guide with examples and prohibited language.
Mark factual claims, links, names, and disclosures that must remain unchanged.
Review final variants for factual accuracy, platform fit, and compliance before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not request a new tone without describing the audience and objective.
Do not ask the skill to invent unsupported product claims.
Do not publish edited content without human approval.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: Provide draft content, brand voice guidance, the target audience, and intended platforms.

faq.question: Will it preserve my facts?
faq.answer: It is designed to preserve supplied facts, but a person should review important claims before publication.

faq.question: Can it adapt one post for multiple platforms?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create platform-specific variants while keeping the core message and brand voice consistent.

faq.question: Does it publish posts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It prepares drafts and does not manage accounts, schedule posts, or publish content.

faq.question: Can it create a brand voice from nothing?
faq.answer: It can suggest edits, but reliable results require examples or clear voice rules.

faq.question: Who should review the output?
faq.answer: A content owner should review tone, factual claims, platform fit, and compliance before publishing.
